about_the_game:
🖱️ Command your clicks. Control your time.

Why It Stands Out

20 clicks per second in up to 20 zones = 400 clicks per second

Unlike generic auto-clickers, Multi Clicker v3 is built for real-time performance and usability. Every control is visible, every action is predictable, and every setting is preserved across sessions.

It’s not just a macro — it’s a precision instrument for speed, testing, and consistency.

Ideal For

Gamers optimizing click-intensive titles

QA testers automating repetitive workflows

Streamers running idle or click-based setups

Developers needing controlled repetition during debugging

Multi Clicker v3 — One window. Full control. Zero wasted motion.

🎯 Key Features

  • Thousands of clicks in seconds or as slow as one click per minute

  • Play 20 games at once

  • Save and switch between 9 profiles instantly

  • Add up to 20 custom click zones per profile

  • Choose between CPS (per second) or CPM (per minute) speed modes

  • Choose between Light or Dark mode

  • Alternate between All or Sequential click patterns

  • Control everything in real time with global hotkeys 

  • Map hotkeys to your preferences

  • Choose to click with LMB or MMB or RMB

  • Lightweight, portable, and no installation required

Built for reliability and tuned for performance, Multi Clicker v2 brings professional-grade mouse automation to anyone — whether you’re grinding idle games, stress-testing interfaces, or saving your wrists from repetitive strain.

  • Stress-testing software UIs – see if your own app or another program can handle rapid input without freezing or crashing.

  • Benchmarking click-detection latency – measure how fast an engine or automation API registers events.

  • Hardware endurance testing – verify mouse drivers, USB polling, or OS input stacks under sustained high frequency.

  • Demonstrating throttle behavior – show where Windows, DirectInput, or a specific game stops recognizing input.

  • QA automation – mass-clicking through repetitive dialogs, confirm buttons, or installer screens for testing purposes.

⚙️ Performance Notice

Possible, though unlikely. (Multi Clicker requires very low CPU usage)
Running multiple clickers at high CPS may exceed hardware or OS event limits on older or low-power systems. Adjust speeds and click counts as needed for your setup.

⚠️ Disclaimer
Multi Clicker is intended for personal and productivity use only. Using automation tools in certain games or applications may violate their Terms of Service. The developer assumes no responsibility for bans, restrictions, or penalties resulting from misuse.

name: Multi Clicker

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 / Radeon Vega 3 or newer)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Basic Auto-clicking utility. Very low resource usage.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560 or newer)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Basic Auto-clicking utility. Very low resource usage.

short_description: Automate your clicks with precision. Multi Clicker v3 supports up to 20 click zones, custom speeds, CPS/CPM modes, and saves 9 profiles. Minimal CPU use, instant response, full real-time control, custom keyboard mapping. Thousands of clicks in seconds. Runs in up to 20 windows at once! Max 400 CPS!
